summary: BW LPG Ltd, through its 52%-owned subsidiary BW LPG India, agreed to sell the 2007-built VLGC BW Birch for continued trading. The sale is expected to generate a net book gain of approximately US$37 million and net cash proceeds of around US$64 million on a 100% basis, at a value equivalent to a newbuilding price of about US$248 million. The vessel is under a time charter with delivery to the buyer by mid-November. CEO Kristian Sørensen framed the sale as execution of the fleet renewal programme, following the recently announced sale of BW Elm. No advisors, premiums, or break fees were disclosed. Watch for delivery completion and comparable vessel sale metrics in the second-hand VLGC market.
